name: CutCraft v0.0 (Release Update - Video Player & Shortcut Fix)
releaseNotes:
CutCraft v0.0 Hotfix Update:
- Fixed Spacebar and keyboard shortcut interception across all focused UI elements (PreviewKeyDown)
- Fixed video player freezing issue by eliminating rapid-seek loop and smooth 1x clock synchronization
- Fixed imported video playback initialization and auto-seeking to clip start
- Added pure C# MP4/WAV metadata header fallback reader for environments without ffprobe
- Added live natural dimension and duration synchronization from MediaOpened
- Updated standalone win-x64 published application package
